### Navigation

We help employers get more value out of their existing benefit spend. We do this by educating participants on how, when, and why to access certain benefits at specific times.

![pexels-alex-green-5699865.jpg](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f4925da1f08b83116823295/1618773475140-ZJTIWP3NCRNA7PNUR21O/pexels-alex-green-5699865.jpg)

### Wellbeing

Situational stressors lead to many challenges for families trying to become pregnant, while they’re pregnant, and during their post-partum recovery. BenefitBump is the only program in the market that addresses the root cause issues impacting emotional health.

![blond-hair-desk-employee-1181534.jpg](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f4925da1f08b83116823295/1618773548553-33MSD3CVFVYU8U1H4ISU/blond-hair-desk-employee-1181534.jpg)

### Return to Work

We fill the “leave gap”, working with participants to address the challenges that impact their ability to return-to-work, including childcare, work/life scheduling, and breastfeeding. The result is higher employee satisfaction and retention.

## BenefitBump Delivers Immediate ROI

![Reduce pregnancy-related stress for parentsNavigators are licensed emotional health professionals that get to know plan participants, understand their stressors, and help them navigate through their benefits during their pregnancy or adoption.](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f4925da1f08b83116823295/1598971088012-MLP2W3X1UA3M94VE73MU/BenefitBump+helps+reduce+pregnancy-related+stress)

**Reduce pregnancy-related stress for parents**

Stress and anxiety are leading drivers of poor birth outcomes. At BenefitBump, our support model improves outcomes. In fact, our premature birth rate is only 1.9%, one-fourth of the national average.

![Higher engagement in benefit plans and programsBenefit Experts are trained benefits professionals that walk participants through plan details, refer them to relevant resources for their personal situation, and assist in employee onboarding and plan enrollment.](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f4925da1f08b83116823295/1598971253839-IU0I7SF1A3DCIVIBSW25/BenefitBump+have+experts+trained+in+maternity+benefits)

**Higher engagement in benefit plans and programs**

They help participants with paperwork, childcare and other preparatory arrangements, and coordinate return-to-work plans with the participant and employer.](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f4925da1f08b83116823295/1598971182931-2E68OWQBU470K89XIXLE/BenefitBump+helps+create+a+higher+rate+of+moms+returning+to+work)

We are experts in leave programs. We serve as a leave concierge, helping participants with paperwork, childcare and other preparatory arrangements, and return-to-work planning. The result is a 94% return-to-work rate for the moms we support.

![Greater job satisfaction and employee engagementIf your company champions work-life family values, we’ll help ensure your actions and words align. **Greater job satisfaction and employee engagement**

If your company champions work-life family values, we’ll help ensure your actions and words align. BenefitBump offers caring support that proactively guides employees through all facets of their benefits and attend to their wellbeing.

[Celebrating Women through BenefitBump \| Human Resources \| Washington University in St. Louis](https://washu.edu/)

This month, we pause to recognize and celebrate all the women across our organization. Women bring strength and compassion to their work and personal communities, and show up every day with remarkable grit and heart.

We recognize that motherhood doesn’t look the same for everyone. The journey can be joyful, challenging, exhausting and deeply rewarding – often all at once. In recognition of the realities working women face every day, WashU is committed to supporting employee who are thinking about or who have expanded their family. As part of that commitment, we are proud to offer BenefitBump, a personalized family support benefit designed to help planning, expecting and current moms navigate parenthood with confidence.

Available to you at no additional cost, BenefitBump’s digital tools and dedicated Care Navigators provide:

- **WashU-specific benefit plan education and navigation** for any path to parenthood (pregnancy, adoption, fostering, surrogacy, fertility treatment, etc.) and for families with kids 12 and under.
- **In-the-moment emotional support** designed to empower you and your family.
- **Practical parenting tools** to help you prepare for the highs and lows of motherhood.
- **24/7 resources**, including articles, on-demand classes, and planning tools.
- Help ordering a **breast pump** and finding a **lactation consultant**.
- Education on **doulas, midwives and other advocacy resources** to support your delivery experience.
- Assistance in **finding in-network healthcare providers** for your family.
- Help creating a **childcare plan**, finding childcare providers and funding that care.
- **Support throughout the maternity leave process**, making sure you have a smooth transition to leave and can focus on what matters most.

This month, we celebrate women. Every day, we strive to support them. **Ready to get started?** Visit [mybenefitbump.com](https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=http%3A%2F%2Fmybenefitbump.com%2F&data=05%7C02%7Csiegismund%40wustl.edu%7Cf0d6562db05c4252bd9c08dea7ab2aa8%7C4ccca3b571cd4e6d974b4d9beb96c6d6%7C0%7C0%7C639132550747903756%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=iR6pA%2B3ddvp%2BJIrOzjBmMiz8b%2BFRuOt9Hm57KO5ZvSE%3D&reserved=0) or download the BenefitBump mobile app using the invitation code **WashU** when registering. For questions, email [participantservices@benefitbump.com](mailto:participantservices@benefitbump.com).

[Learn more online](https://hr.wustl.edu/items/benefitbump/) and contact HR’s Benefits Service Center with questions: Call 314-935-2332 (option #1) or email [hr-benefitsmail@wustl.edu](mailto:hr-benefitsmail@wustl.edu).

# For the Many Paths to Parenthood

At BenefitBump, we are dedicated to delivering benefit education and advocacy to expanding families in a holistic, caring way to help workforces perform better.

BenefitBump participants are guided through their pregnancy, fertility, surrogacy, or adoption journey by a trained care team focused the benefits, leave programs, and emotional needs of growing families. Our singular focus ensures that we deliver expert and appropriate care and guidance to all participants.

_“BenefitBump took on a strategic role in the planning, implementation and marketing in providing our employees with a family support system.”_

\- VP HR, Law Firm Client

[![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f4925da1f08b83116823295/53a9a75d-8ac5-4fba-ba08-56452e2e1af5/register.png)](https://www.benefitbump.com/mobile)

#### **Register**

Our self-service BenefitBump tools make registration easy and allows your participants to keep track of their progress with reminders and checklists.

- Easy sign up, onboarding, and orientation

- Participants can connect with their designated care team

- Push notifications and reminders


* * *

[![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f4925da1f08b83116823295/bcf21818-f12a-4bfe-8671-09dcad472dc4/navigate+%281%29.png)](https://www.benefitbump.com/mobile)

#### **Navigate**

Your participant’s main point of contact is the Care Navigator, a master’s level emotional health professional who works with participants and their families throughout the entire journey.

- Gets to know participants personally and completes the intake process

- Guides participants around the BenefitBump program

- Conducts regular benefit and well-being check-ins


* * *

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f4925da1f08b83116823295/5724599e-1fac-4ce8-b042-414f88160d2e/leave+help.png)

#### **Optimize**

Behind the scenes, our benefit experts ensure that our navigators are intimately familiar with your company’s benefit program details, so navigators can:

- Walk through benefit plans, including time off and leave

- Refer participants to relevant resources for their personal situation

BenefitBump participants are guided through their pregnancy, infertility, or adoption journey by a trained care team focused on benefits, leave programs, and emotional needs for growing families. Emotional Support – The primary point-of-contact on the BenefitBump care team is a master’s level emotional health professional. Their role is to get to know participants so we can serve them best. Care Navigators are available through in-app messaging, email, and telephone.

Project Management – BenefitBump care teams help participants get everything done. Our program deploys a personalized “checklist” of tips, reminders, and benefit and time-off program information that varies based on each participant’s path to parenthood. Choose your “life event” in the app and your personalized journey will be served up to you.

Leave Advocacy – Leave advocates educate participants on their time off programs, help them complete paperwork and claim forms, and collaborate to craft a return-to-work plan, if that’s their intention. Our primary objectives are to help participants be more planful as they prepare for their leave and to help ensure that they have the support needed to ensure a smooth return-to-work. ![BenefitBump Logo](https://stifel.wellnessiq.org/wp-content/uploads/sites/73/2024/04/BenefitBump-Logo.png)

BenefitBump provides benefit navigation and support to planning and expectant parents on all paths to parenthood – pregnancy, adoption, fertility treatment, and surrogacy. We ensure associates understand and optimize their employer-provided benefits along the journey and help them stay on top of the need to dos of their journey – apply for leave, enroll their child in benefits, develop a childcare plan, and so much more. Each associate is matched with a dedicated Care Navigator. That Care Navigator will be there throughout the associate’s journey to parenthood, providing benefit education and in-the-moment emotional support. In addition to our Navigators, associates can engage in a customized app that hosts their employer’s benefit information. Our goal is to reduce stress and improve the well-being of every individual on their journey to parenthood.

## Resources

[mybenefitbump.com](https://mybenefitbump.com/public/sign-up)

To learn how to become a great consumer of these benefits, please use the resources below. These resources are available to you through our partnership with this vendor.

![](https://hr.wustl.edu/files/2024/12/Benefitbump-logo.jpg)

BenefitBump at WashU: Your Family Planning Support Program

## What is BenefitBump?

Starting January 1, 2025, WashU offers BenefitBump to all eligible employees, their spouses/domestic partners and eligible dependents.

A personalized support program that helps you:

- Access resources for a healthy pregnancy, adoption and fostering
- Navigate WashU’s family-related benefits and leave policies
- Connect with dedicated Care Navigators
- Plan for leave and return-to-work transitions

_Note:_ Eligible employees and their spouses/domestic partners do not need to be enrolled in a WashU health insurance plan to utilize this program.

## How to Get Started

1. **SIGN UP**

    • at [myBenefitbump.com](https://mybenefitbump.com/public/sign-up)

    • download the app: [Apple](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/benefitbump/id1542658541) \| [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.benefitbump.app.client)

Use the invitation code ‘ **WashU**‘
2. A dedicated Care Navigator will follow up to

schedule a call.
3. Use the app for tools and resources.
4. Receive your free gift!
5. Questions? Call [888-286-7314](tel:+18882867314) or email [participantservices@benefitbump.com](mailto:participantservices@benefitbump.com).

Your privacy is protected with BenefitBump and WashU. [Read WashU’s privacy policy online](https://hr.wustl.edu/privacy/).

###### Mobile app

![](https://hr.wustl.edu/files/2024/12/BB-screen-350x666.jpg)**Sign up on the app**

[Apple](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/benefitbump/id1542658541) \| [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.benefitbump.app.client)

###### website

![](https://hr.wustl.edu/files/2024/12/screen.jpg)[**Sign up online at MyBenefitBump.com!**](https://mybenefitbump.com/public/sign-up)

## Comprehensive Support Areas

###### Family Planning & Fertility

###### Pregnancy & Birth

###### Adoption & Fostering

###### Early Parenthood

###### Work-Life Integration

_Each area includes:_

- One-on-one support from Care Navigators
- Access to educational resources
- Connection to WashU benefits
- Guidance through important transitions

## FAQs

What is BenefitBump and why should I use it?

BenefitBump is a free support program for WashU employees who are planning to grow their families or have young children. Whether you’re considering pregnancy, adoption, fostering or fertility treatment, or already have children under five, BenefitBump provides personalized guidance to help you understand and make the most of your WashU benefits and related resources.

**Who can use BenefitBump?**

BenefitBump is available to all WashU faculty, staff, postdocs and clinical fellows who are eligible for WashU benefits. You don’t need to be enrolled in WashU’s benefits to use the program – you just need to be eligible. Your spouse/partner can also use the program, even if they don’t work at WashU.

**Is BenefitBump only for pregnancy support?**

No – BenefitBump supports all paths to parenthood, including:

- Pregnancy and childbirth
- Adoption and fostering
- Fertility treatment and surrogacy
- Support for families with children under five
- Planning and preparation for any of these paths

**How much does it cost?**

BenefitBump is completely free for you and your family. WashU provides this program as part of your benefits package.

**Is my participation confidential?**

Yes. Your participation in BenefitBump, including all conversations with your Care Navigator, is completely confidential and will not be shared with your manager or WashU.

**What happens after I sign up?**

You’ll be matched with a dedicated Care Navigator – a trained emotional health professional who understands WashU’s benefits. This person will be your consistent point of contact, helping you navigate benefits, prepare for leave, plan childcare and access resources throughout your journey.

[Additional FAQs (PDF)](https://wustl.box.com/s/skc3lpnmwb8bnxbtn3wloqlowipzo6ef)

[Download a BenefitBump flyer (PDF)](https://wustl.box.com/s/yse1xxy54gtu4ck06za2fhi6cdoc43eq)

Contact BenefitBump for Support

Email [participantservices@benefitbump.com](mailto:participantservices@benefitbump.com) or call 888-286-7314.

Looking for more family care WashU benefits? Visit the WashU [Work-Life & Family Care hub](https://hr.wustl.edu/well-being/family-care/).

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f4925da1f08b83116823295/1598982689251-T55CHNLQGYZ3O19EYK7J/alt+about+pic.jpg)

# About BenefitBump

As benefits experts and working parents, we knew that we could make the employee experience better, so we created BenefitBump.

### Why did we create BenefitBump?

The need for maternal mental health resources, family benefit education, and leave advocacy is high, but most vendor solutions leave mental health in the background and treat benefit issues as simply transactional. This means employers are not able to maximize the impact of benefit programs for expanding families and employees are left to navigate an incomplete or confusing patchwork of programs on their own.

Studies since the 1950’s have made the connection between birth complications and high levels of prenatal stress and anxiety. And many studies on post-partum depression find that relationship and financial stressors are the key contributors. These risk factors are addressable, but complicated. Situational stressors, or these root cause issues, require a cross-functional support structure that helps with addressing sources of financial anxiety, relationship strain, logistical challenges, and caring support. The BenefitBump model was built to meet this challenge. At BenefitBump, we put emotional health at the front door and provide the expertise required to help participants know what to do, when to do it, and we help them get things done. This ensures that our participants get the holistic support they need and deserve.

How do we do it? Our trained mental health professionals get to know participants, understand our clients’ benefit plans and time off programs, and conduct educational and emotional well-being check-ins at critical times. We started BenefitBump because growing families deserve a better system than we have today. The competition for talent is intense, expectations are high, and supporting employees during this exciting time makes business sense.

BenefitBump is for all paths to parenthood and all client types. Contact us at 866-286-7440 to learn more.

#### Our Vision

Our vision is to be the “easy button” for growing families as they navigate their benefits, time off, and wellbeing, resulting in better business results for our clients and improved outcomes for our participants.

#### Our Purpose

To improve gender equity and inclusion in the workplace, by delivering the resources growing families need to successfully balance work and life.

#### Our Mission

BenefitBump’s mission is to provide customized benefit navigation and emotional support to ease employees’ journeys during life’s critical milestones.

## FAQs

#### The Case for BenefitBump

Q: Simply put, why should we offer BenefitBump?

A: Benefits and leave program are complex. Many people, and especially recent parents, we surveyed while developing BenefitBump were unaware of most of the programs available to them through their employer’s benefits. This means that you are not getting an optimal ROI on your benefit program. BenefitBump’s care navigation model walks participants through important educational reminders, tips, and transactional support before, during, and after pregnancy and adoption. Our approach will lead to lower stress, time savings for your employees and your benefits and HR staff, and better financial and health outcomes.

Q: We offer a lot of benefit plans and programs, we’re not sure that our benefit ecosystem can handle another program, so why would we implement BenefitBump?

A: BenefitBump can bring order to your benefit ecosystem by serving as a hub for all of your benefits. We educate and connect participants with the valuable programs that employers purchase and implement to improve the health and wellbeing of the workforce.

Q: We are a national employer with a diverse workforce, can BenefitBump help us?

A: Our curriculum is designed to apply to employee populations anywhere in the U.S. and regardless of family structure. Our primary purpose is to connect your workforce to available tools and resources and to help them navigate through the numerous steps on their journey to parenthood, whether it is their first child or not, whether they are giving birth or adopting, and wherever they are in the process.

* * *

#### Registration and engaging with the BenefitBump care team

Q: How do I register for BenefitBump?

A: Registration is easy. Call us at 888-BUMP-314 (888-286-7314) or download the BenefitBump app on the [Apple AppStore](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/benefitbump/id1542658541) or [Google Play Store](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.benefitbump.app.client). You will simply need to tell us who you work for, or your partner’s employer if they are the company offering BenefitBump. Then, we’ll help you register.

Q: How will employees learn about BenefitBump?

A: BenefitBump will work with you to develop a comprehensive communications plan. Marketing materials include posters, email announcements, content to add to your new hire and annual benefit enrollment information and intranet, and a brief video to share with your field HR staff and line-managers to education them on the program.

Q: Is BenefitBump only for pregnant employees?

A: No, BenefitBump is for the entire family. Plus, our resources are available pre-pregnancy or adoption, during pregnancy or an adoption process, and post-delivery or successful adoption. Just as important, BenefitBump is there for participants when things don’t go as planned such as the loss of a baby or complications during an adoption.

Q: How does the BenefitBump care team help participants understand their benefits?

A: We load your benefits and leave programs into the BenefitBump toolkit, both at our care team’s fingertips and your employee’s. These tools will include details on all of your benefit plans and programs and additional community resources available to participants. But, more importantly, each participant is connected with a navigator who gets to know their needs and concerns, they are part project manager and part coach. And like the participants, the navigator is not alone, they have the help of other team members, including benefits and leave experts.

* * *

#### Benefit navigation & to-do list

Q: What do you mean by benefit navigation?

A: BenefitBump is designed to help employees learn about, and use, all of the benefits and programs the employer offers related to pregnancy, childbirth, and adoption. The Care Navigator will guide participants through all of these programs, helping them get the most out of their benefits.

Q: Do BenefitBump’s services end when participants have their baby or complete their adoption?

A: No, BenefitBump encourages participants to maintain check-in calls for the first year after birth or adoption, perhaps on a less frequent basis. We will also provide content and resources to assist families beyond the first year of life.

Q: How does your program work with our existing benefit plans?

A: BenefitBump is designed to optimize your entire benefit package. We communicate relevant plan and program information, connect participants to available resources offered through your other benefit plan vendors, and help participants navigate the activities they should complete in order to take advantage of the benefits you offer.

* * *

#### Leave planning and advocacy

Q: What is the role of a Leave Advocate?

A: Leave Advocates help participants prepare for their maternity or parental leave and return to work, if that’s the employee’s plan. They will help employees understand the employer’s time off programs, complete forms, and connect particpants to resources that they may need before, during, or after their leave, such as childcare.

Q: What do you mean by the term “leave advocacy”?

A: Leave advocates are in place to work with employees and their supervisors to determine what conditions need to be met to enable a productive return to work. Advocates work with participants to ensure that they have childcare in place, that their work hours fit with their childcare plan and parenting expectations, and/or to help employees evaluate other jobs within their company that might be a better fit for their growing family. For supervisors, the advocate improves the communication between the employee and the supervisor around changing expectations and works to establish a win-win for the employee and the supervisor.

Q: Leave is confusing with FMLA, vacation time, sick leave, short-term disability, paid family leave, parental leave, etc. How will BenefitBump bring order to these programs.

A: Let BenefitBump be your leave “expert”. We will develop a client customized tool that helps participants map out their income sources and job protections while they are on their childbirth or adoption journey. Participant advice will be based on your benefit plans and their state or local entitlements.

* * *

#### Check-in calls

Q: The program encourages participants to schedule regular check-in calls with their care team. What happens on these calls?

A: One of the primary goals of the program is to reduce the stress of our participants. The check-in calls are a great opportunity to visit with participants to better understand their life situation and concerns, plus it’s a great time to get things done. In addition to a general check-in on the participant's well-being, we also help participants work through the to-do’s related to navigating benefits, enrolling in programs, completing forms, and more during the call.

Q: Will participants be able to work with the same navigator throughout their pregnancy?

A: Yes. Since BenefitBump interactions are scheduled, we can work around vacation schedules to ensure that navigators are consistently available to their customers.

Q: What resources will be available to employees/families to help them understand their benefits?

A: Employees and their families will have access to a personalized MyBenefitBump.com website and mobile application. These tools will include details on all resources available to participants. But, more importantly, each participant is connected with a navigator who helps them understand and access their benefits. The navigator is the head of a care team that includes emotional support professionals, benefit experts, and leave advocates.

Q: What do you mean when you say that BenefitBump is an appointment-based model? What happens if participants have a question between calls?

A: Your employees’ time is valuable. BenefitBump believes the best way to ensure that participants get the help they need, when they need it, is to establish regular telephonic discussions with participants. For individuals that would prefer to self-guide, MyBenefitBump.com or the mobile app will provide them with comprehensive benefit plan education and support. If participants have questions between calls or don’t understand information on the site/app, they are welcome to message us through the app/website or to call BenefitBump during normal business hours to talk with an emotional health, benefits, or leave expert.

* * *

Have more questions about BenefitBump?
